items.jp: 列車はすぐに来ると思います。

translation.en: I think the train will come soon.

items.explanation: Junto de すぐ, に forma すぐに ('logo, em seguida'), indicando quando o trem vem.

items.jp: 旅行でこのガイドブックが役に立つかもしれませんよ。

items.label: elemento fixo da expressão 役に立つ
items.explanation: Este に amarra 役 a 立つ na expressão pronta 役に立つ ('ser útil'); não é o に de destino nem o de tempo.
tokens: situação em que a coisa se aplica

items.jp: 要するに、彼が不注意だったのだ。

translation.pt-BR: Resumindo, ele foi descuidado.
translation.en: In brief, he was careless.

items.label: peça fixa da locução 要するに
items.explanation: Aqui に não marca nada sozinho: ele fecha a expressão pronta 要するに ('resumindo', 'em suma'), que abre a frase.

items.jp: 友人の選択においては注意深くあるべきだ。

translation.pt-BR: Na hora de escolher os amigos, é preciso ter cuidado.

items.label: に de 〜において ('no que toca a')
items.explanation: Este に abre a expressão 〜において e delimita o campo: quando o assunto é escolher os amigos.

items.jp: 木が多すぎると家に光が射さない。

items.label: marks the place reached by the action
items.explanation: に indicates the house as the point where the light should reach/strike. With 射す, it is に that points to the destination of the light.

items.jp: 味は日本のお米に比べて遜色はありません。

translation.en: It tastes every bit as good as Japanese rice.

items.label: base of the comparison
items.explanation: に links お米 to the verb 比べる, forming に比べて (compared with).
tokens: basis of the comparison (with に比べて)
part of the grammatical pattern に比べて

items.jp: 万事はその結果いかんにかかっている。

items.label: complement marker (of the dependence)
items.explanation: に marks その結果いかん as that on which everything depends, required by the verb かかる.

items.jp: 僕は君に追いついた。

translation.pt-BR: Eu te alcancei.
translation.en: I caught up with you.

items.label: destination/direction particle
items.explanation: に marca 君 como quem foi alcançado; 追いつく pede に para o alvo.

items.jp: 僕には相談相手がない。

translation.pt-BR: Não tenho ninguém para pedir conselho.

items.label: destination/direction particle
items.explanation: に marca 僕 como a pessoa em cuja esfera a coisa existiria; com ない, dá 'eu não tenho'.

items.jp: 壁に時計が掛かっている。

items.label: destination/direction particle
items.explanation: に marca 壁 como o lugar onde o relógio está pendurado, o ponto de apoio do estado descrito por 掛かっている.

items.jp: 柄にもないことを言うな。

items.label: に da locução 柄にもない (fora do feitio)

items.jp: 彼女は母親に劣らず美しい。

items.jp: 彼女は夫を尻に敷いている。

items.jp: 彼女には素晴らしい語学の才がある。

items.jp: 彼らは暮らしに余裕がない。

items.jp: 彼らは信仰の自由のために戦った。

items.jp: 彼らは現地人に同化しなかった。

items.label: destination/direction particle

items.jp: 彼らは丘の上に立った。

items.jp: 彼らはうまくその仕事に就いた。

items.explanation: に marca その仕事 como o posto em que eles entraram; 仕事に就く é a expressão fixa para 'assumir um emprego'.

items.jp: 彼らの友情は深い愛情に発展した。

items.label: destination/direction particle
items.explanation: に aponta 深い愛情 como o ponto em que a amizade foi parar; com 発展する, に marca o resultado da transformação.

items.jp: 彼は礼儀にかけている。

items.jp: 礼には及びません。

items.explanation: Este に prende 礼 a 及ぶ: é até o agradecimento que a necessidade não chega.

items.jp: 彼は僕に外国へ行きたいかどうかと聞いた。

items.label: particle (to whom)
items.explanation: に marks 僕 ('me') as the recipient of the question ('asked ME').

items.jp: 授業の予習をしてくるべきだったのに。

translation.en: You should have prepared for the lesson.

items.label: concessive particle (のに, 'although')
items.explanation: Together with the preceding の it forms のに, leaving the sentence in suspense with a tone of regret: 'even though I should have...'.

items.jp: 本棚にはまだ読んでいない本が山のようにある。

translation.en: There are many books on the shelf that I have yet to read.

items.label: comparative link (の of ように)
items.explanation: の links 山 to よう within のように ('like a mountain'), expressing comparison.

items.jp: 寒いのでマフラーを締めた

translation.pt-BR: Como estava frio, coloquei o cachecol.
translation.en: Since it was cold, I put on a scarf.

items.label: nominalizer (forms ので)
items.explanation: の turns the clause 寒い into a nominal base and, together with で, forms ので, which expresses cause ('because it is cold').

items.jp: 暑いので冷房をつけます

translation.pt-BR: Como está calor, vou ligar o ar-condicionado.
translation.en: Since it's hot, I'll turn on the air conditioner.

items.label: nominalizer within ので (causal conjunction)
items.explanation: This の is part of the conjunction ので, which links a cause ('since it is hot') to a consequence. ので sounds more explanatory and polite than から.

items.jp: 騒いでいたのでバスの運転手はこちらを睨んだ。

translation.en: The bus driver glared at us for shouting.

items.label: nominalizer (substantivizing の)
items.explanation: This の turns the clause 騒いでいた into something nominal, preparing it to take ので and express the cause ('the fact that we were making noise').

items.jp: 授業の予習をしてくるべきだったのに。

translation.pt-BR: Eu devia ter estudado a matéria antes da aula...
translation.en: You should have prepared for the lesson.

items.label: nominalizer (の)
items.explanation: Turns the clause 〜べきだった into something のに can attach to; here it prepares the hook for the following particle.

items.jp: 事態は悪化するのではないかと思う。

translation.pt-BR: Acho que a situação pode acabar piorando.

items.label: nominalizer (the の that turns the clause into a noun)
items.explanation: の (準体助詞) nominalizes the clause 悪化する, allowing it to be followed by ではないか; it is the の that packages 'the situation worsening' as a concept about which one is doubtful.

items.jp: 友達を苛めるのはよくない

items.label: marks the topic/subject
items.explanation: は points to 彼 ('he') as the one who performed the action of asking in the main clause.

items.jp: 目的を果たすのはきつそうだった。

translation.pt-BR: Parecia difícil cumprir o objetivo.
translation.en: It looked tough to achieve his aim.

items.label: topic marker
items.explanation: は apresenta esse bloco nominalizado como o assunto: é sobre 'cumprir o objetivo' que se faz o comentário.
tokens: cópula だ no passado (parte de だった)

items.jp: 味は日本のお米に比べて遜色はありません。

translation.pt-BR: Em sabor, não fica nada atrás do arroz japonês.
translation.en: It tastes every bit as good as Japanese rice.

items.label: topic marker
items.explanation: は marks 味 as the topic, 'as for the taste'.
tokens: basis of the comparison (with に比べて)
part of the grammatical pattern に比べて

items.jp: 物価が上がるのは確かだ。

translation.pt-BR: É certo que os preços vão subir.
translation.en: It is certain that prices will go up.

items.label: topic marker
items.explanation: は presents the nominalized block 上がるの as the topic about which the statement 確かだ is made.

items.jp: 彼女は高校生だが、彼氏は大学生だ。

translation.pt-BR: Ela está no ensino médio, mas o namorado dela está na faculdade.
translation.en: She's in high school, but her boyfriend is in college.

items.label: marks the topic
items.explanation: は presents 彼女 ('she') as the topic of the first clause.

items.jp: 彼女は高校生だが、彼氏は大学生だ。

translation.pt-BR: Ela está no ensino médio, mas o namorado dela está na faculdade.
translation.en: She's in high school, but her boyfriend is in college.

items.label: marks the topic
items.explanation: は presents 彼氏 ('the boyfriend') as the topic of the second clause, in contrast with 彼女.

items.jp: 父は事故を恐れて車の運転をしない。

translation.pt-BR: Meu pai não dirige por medo de acidentes.
translation.en: For fear of an accident, my father doesn't drive.

items.label: topic marker
items.explanation: は presents 父 as the topic: 'as for my father,...'. It signals who is being talked about before giving the information.

items.jp: 秘密をしゃべってしまったのはだれだ。

translation.pt-BR: Quem foi que acabou contando o segredo?
translation.en: Who is guilty of telling the secret?

items.label: marks the topic in focus
items.explanation: は highlights the nominalized block: 'as for who told the secret...', leaving the identity (だれ) as the focus of the question.

items.jp: お箸で食べるのは難しいですか？

translation.pt-BR: É difícil comer com hashis?
translation.en: Is it difficult to eat with chopsticks?

items.label: marks the topic of the sentence
items.explanation: は presents 'eating with chopsticks' as the theme about which the question is asked: 'as for that, is it difficult?'.

items.jp: 彼女は行ってしまった。ぼくは泣きたい気分だ。

translation.pt-BR: Ela foi embora. Estou com vontade de chorar.
translation.en: She has gone. I feel like crying.

items.label: topic marker
items.explanation: は presents 彼女 ('she') as the theme of the first sentence.

items.jp: 彼女は行ってしまった。ぼくは泣きたい気分だ。

translation.pt-BR: Ela foi embora. Estou com vontade de chorar.
translation.en: She has gone. I feel like crying.

items.label: topic marker
items.explanation: は presents ぼく ('I') as the theme of the second sentence, in implicit contrast with 彼女.

items.jp: 彼女、文句ばっかり。

translation.pt-BR: Ela só sabe reclamar.
translation.en: She does nothing but complain.

items.label: limitation ('only / nothing but')
items.explanation: ばっかり é a forma coloquial de ばかり e prende 文句: nada além de reclamação sai dela.

items.jp: 夜遅くまで騒がないでください

translation.pt-BR: Por favor, não faça barulho até tarde da noite.
translation.en: Please don't make noise late at night.

items.label: temporal limit ('until')
items.explanation: まで marks the endpoint in time: the request not to make noise applies 'until' late at night.

items.jp: 沖まで泳ぐのは危ない

translation.pt-BR: Nadar até o alto-mar é perigoso.
translation.en: Swimming out to the open sea is dangerous.

items.label: limit particle ('until')
items.explanation: まで marks 沖 as the end point of the swimming route.

items.jp: グラスの縁までいっぱいにして。

translation.pt-BR: Enche o copo até a boca.
translation.en: Fill the glass to the brim.

items.label: partícula de limite (espacial)
items.explanation: まで marca グラスの縁 como o limite do enchimento: o líquido sobe até ali e para.

items.jp: この本は第二次大戦までしか扱っていない。

translation.pt-BR: Este livro só vai até a Segunda Guerra Mundial.
translation.en: This book only goes down to World War II.

items.label: temporal limit ('until')
items.explanation: まで marca 第二次大戦 como o ponto onde o livro para; aqui o limite é de tempo, o fim do período coberto.

items.jp: 君も同様僕も悪くない。

translation.pt-BR: Nem você nem eu temos culpa.
translation.en: I am not any more to blame than you are.

items.label: も of inclusion ('also')
items.explanation: Este も inclui 君 e abre o par も…も que a frase vai fechar com 僕も.

items.jp: 君も同様僕も悪くない。

translation.pt-BR: Nem você nem eu temos culpa.
translation.en: I am not any more to blame than you are.

items.label: も of inclusion ('also')
items.explanation: O segundo も inclui 僕 e fecha o par: a negação 悪くない cobre os dois.

items.jp: 他人に聞くまえに検索してよ。

translation.pt-BR: Antes de perguntar pros outros, pesquisa, vai.
translation.en: Do research before asking others.

items.label: emphatic sentence-final particle
items.explanation: よ reinforces the advice given to the listener, with a direct, informal tone: "go on", "you know".
tokens: component of the compound verb 検索する

items.jp: アイス買ってきてよ、カップ系のやつ。

translation.pt-BR: Compra um sorvete pra mim, daqueles em potinho.
translation.en: Buy me an ice cream, one of those in a little cup.

items.label: emphatic sentence-final particle
items.explanation: よ adds emphasis/insistence to the request, like 'go on', 'okay?' or '!' in English. It marks that the speaker is informing or pressing something on the listener.
tokens: auxiliary verb (pattern 〜てくる: go do and bring back)
head noun of the final complement

items.jp: 謝ったんだから、さっきのはチャラにしてよ。

translation.pt-BR: Já pedi desculpas, então esquece o que rolou agora há pouco, vai.
translation.en: I've apologised, so lay off, OK?

items.label: emphatic sentence-final particle
items.explanation: よ adds emphasis to the appeal, like a 'come on/okay?' that gently presses the listener.

items.jp: 風邪をひかないようにしなさいよ。

translation.pt-BR: Cuide para não pegar resfriado, viu?
translation.en: Take care not to catch a cold.

items.label: sentence-final particle of emphasis/warning
items.explanation: よ at the end adds a tone of friendly warning to the listener: 'see? / okay?'.
tokens: part of the phrase ように

items.jp: たまには赤ちゃんを泣かせておくのもいい。

translation.pt-BR: De vez em quando, também não tem problema deixar o bebê chorar.
translation.en: It's OK to leave the baby to cry on occasion.

items.label: direct-object particle を
items.explanation: Marks 赤ちゃん as the target of the causative verb 泣かせる ('to make the baby cry').

items.jp: 謝ったんだから、さっきのはチャラにしてよ。

translation.pt-BR: Já pedi desculpas, então esquece o que rolou agora há pouco, vai.
translation.en: I've apologised, so lay off, OK?

items.label: colloquial nominalizer (= の)
items.explanation: ん turns the clause 謝った into something nominal so it can take だから; it is the spoken/contracted version of の.
